75: // Description - Bulk create-or-update operation on exposed on-premise systems. This handler supports two types of reports - full and delta.
76: // This handler takes a list of fully described SCCs together with the exposed systems.
77: // It creates new application for every exposed system for which CMP isn't aware of, and updates the metadata for the ones it is.
78: // - In case of full report: If there is SCC which was not reported, all exposed systems of this SCC are marked as unreachable.
79: // - In case of delta report: If there are missing exposed systems for a particular SCC, these systems are marked as unreachable.
80: // URL          - /api/v1/notifications
81: // Query Params - reportType=[full, delta]
